description: Where everything lives (production build). Measured with nvidia-smi, SGLang /metrics and /proc.

hardware.gpu: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 96 GB (97,887 MiB), SM120, PCIe Gen4 x16 (board limit)

vram.other_weights_fp8_online_mxfp8_gb: about 8-16 (16-bit on disk, converted at load)

kv_cache.why_small: only 12 of 48 layers use full attention with a KV cache; 36 are Gated DeltaNet layers with a fixed-size state

vram.state_cache: mamba/GDN state slots, --max-mamba-cache-size 24 (5 slots per request)
